why: B runs one 14 px stroke-icon family through the top bar, the project card and the composer, and locks it to the text cap band rather than floating it; A's control detail is exact (six 18 px caption swatches on a 26 px pitch, four identical 28x16 px toggles), but it has no icon system to show, so only B demonstrates the icon family this category asks for.
